description: CLI tools for event ingest, query, subscribe, and stats

requirements.title: ScenarioApp integration
requirements.description: CLI built on cli-core ScenarioApp with auto-config, API client, and consistent UX

requirements.title: Auto-config port detection
requirements.description: CLI auto-detects API port via vrooli scenario port discovery

requirements.title: Fallback to default port
requirements.description: CLI falls back to configured default port when auto-detection fails

requirements.title: Consistent error formatting
requirements.description: CLI formats API errors with consistent human-readable output

requirements.title: Query command
requirements.description: vrooli-events query with --type, --source, --correlation-id, --since, --limit, --json flags

requirements.title: Subscribe command
requirements.description: vrooli-events subscribe with --type, --source, --target, --json flags

requirements.title: Stats command
requirements.description: vrooli-events stats shows store health, subscriber count, event count, size

requirements.title: Ingest command
requirements.description: vrooli-events ingest with --event-id, --type, --source, --target, --correlation-id, --payload, --json flags

requirements.title: Default port from config file
requirements.description: Falls back to port from scenario config file before hardcoded default

requirements.title: Structured error with exit codes
requirements.description: Different exit codes for connection errors, validation errors, and server errors

requirements.title: Query flag parsing
requirements.description: Parses --type, --source, --correlation-id, --since, --limit flags with validation

requirements.title: Since timestamp format validation
requirements.description: Validates --since as RFC3339 timestamp or duration string

requirements.title: Query output formatting
requirements.description: Supports --json for machine output and human-readable table for terminal

requirements.title: SSE connection establishment
requirements.description: Opens EventSource connection with pattern filter query parameters

requirements.title: Connection retry on failure
requirements.description: Auto-retries SSE connection with backoff on network errors

requirements.title: Graceful shutdown on signal
requirements.description: SIGINT/SIGTERM cleanly closes SSE connection and flushes output

requirements.title: Health endpoint request
requirements.description: Calls GET /health and parses response into structured stats

requirements.title: Connection timeout handling
requirements.description: Times out after configurable duration with clear error message

requirements.title: Stats output modes
requirements.description: Table format for terminal, --json for machine consumption

requirements.title: Event envelope construction
requirements.description: Builds EventEnvelope from --event-id, --type, --source, --target, --correlation-id flags

requirements.title: Auto-generated event ID
requirements.description: Generates UUID event ID when --event-id not provided

requirements.title: Ingest response handling
requirements.description: Displays success with event ID or structured error on failure
